newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hoechst appoints HMR executive committee.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst appoints HMR executive committee.

text.p: German chemicals and drugs group Hoechst AG said on Thursday that a six-person executive committee has been formed at its Hoechst Marion Roussel drugs unit.
Hoechst management board member Horst Waesche said the integration process of the drugs unit had proceeded according to plan.
The unit was now focusing on improving its competitiveness, Waesche added.

Hoechst said that the following people have been appointed members of the HMR Executive Committee: Jean-Pierre Godard, chief executive, Richard Markham, chief operating officer, Frank Douglas, head of research, Rotraut Labs, head of development, Charles Langston, chief administrative officer, Alban Schuele, chief financial officer.
